objective1.dial: The Machines are mobilizing in the real world. Hovercrafts are reporting Sentinel clusters near Zion. The Truce is over.

objective2.dial: Accessing Zion mainframe... defense grid online.

objective3.dial: Truce condition violated by human anomalies. Extermination protocols engaged.

objective5.dial: The sector is destabilizing! We have to get them out!

objective7.dial: You survived us once. You will not survive us again.

objective8.dial: We held them off here, but the war has restarted. Which side will you stand on?
